name: Side-lying Leg in Strap

load.note: A single light spring is also an option when the aim is control.

summary: Lying on one side with the top foot in a long loop. A family of leg presses, sweeps and circles for the glutes and outer hip.
steps: Headrest up. Lie on one side, head on the headrest, hips towards the back edge and knees bent towards the front.
Long loop over the top foot; stack hips and shoulders.
Lift the underneath waist off the carriage.
Breathe out to press the top leg towards the footbar; breathe in to bend it back to hip height.

layers.title: Straight-leg sweep
layers.text: Long leg sweeps forward and back.

layers.title: Hip opener
layers.text: Long leg lifts up and lowers.

layers.title: Clams
layers.text: Knees bent, open and close the top knee; hold the carriage still.

layers.title: Propped
layers.text: Up on the forearm for more waist work.

cautions.note: Stay in a small, mid range; no crossing the midline.
Avoid lying on a sore hip; small range.

cues:
Top hip reaches away from the ribs so both sides of the waist stay long.
Hips stay back and stacked — the top one doesn't roll.
Knee comes back level with the hip, not into the chest.
Don't tuck the tail.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Take spring off if the pelvis rocks
Small ball or cushion under the head
